<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#110053" opacity="0.78"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>

    <rect x="361" y="13" width="15" height="9" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <g opacity="0.45">
    <line x1="20" y1="77" x2="370" y2="77" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>

  </g>

  <!-- menu tray shadow and surface -->
  <rect x="0" y="241" width="390" height="563" fill="#0F0142" opacity="0.18"/>
  <rect x="0" y="234" width="390" height="563" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="166" y="249" width="58" height="5" rx="3" fill="#B6B6B6"/>

  <line x1="24" y1="310" x2="366" y2="310" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- boarding pass option -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="327" width="354" height="56" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>

    <line x1="39" y1="354" x2="50" y2="354" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="75" y="361" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Tarjeta de embarque</text>
    <polyline points="347,348 353,354 347,360" fill="none" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- itinerary option -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="391" width="354" height="56" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="419" r="12" fill="#EFEDFA" stroke="#4658E0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="419" r="3" fill="#4658E0"/>
    <line x1="47" y1="419" x2="47" y2="411" stroke="#4658E0" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <polyline points="347,412 353,418 347,424" fill="none" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- seats option -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="455" width="354" height="56" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="483" r="13" fill="#1B0188"/>

    <polyline points="347,476 353,482 347,488" fill="none" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- luggage option -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="519" width="354" height="56" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="38" y="531" width="19" height="24" rx="4" fill="#EFEDFA" stroke="#0BAEAF" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <polyline points="347,540 353,546 347,552" fill="none" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- manage trip option -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="583" width="354" height="56" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="611" r="12" fill="#EFEDFA" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <line x1="61" y1="611" x2="57" y2="611" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="2"/>

    <polyline points="347,604 353,610 347,616" fill="none" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="710" width="342" height="42" rx="7" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
    <circle cx="47" cy="731" r="10" fill="#4658E0"/>
    <line x1="47" y1="725" x2="47" y2="734" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

    <text x="68" y="736" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Centro de ayuda</text>
    <polyline points="342,726 347,731 342,736" fill="none" stroke="#EA104C" stroke-width="2"/>

  <rect x="0" y="797" width="390" height="47" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <g>
    <polygon points="39,812 49,804 59,812 59,823 52,823 52,815 46,815 46,823 39,823" fill="#110053"/>

  <g>
    <rect x="124" y="806" width="17" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="128" y1="810" x2="137" y2="810" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <g>

    <circle cx="215" cy="809" r="2.5" fill="#5C5C5C"/>

    <text x="215" y="839" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Cuenta</text>

    <line x1="304" y1="807" x2="304" y2="813" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="304" y1="813" x2="309" y2="816" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="304" y="839" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="10px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Más</text>
  </g>
</svg>
